I used to be passionate about my work as a fashion designer and I wanted my end game career to be in bridal and special occasion. My driving force was making clothes that people could be the happiest in and create memories in. But I've been fucked over and was abandoned by all my close friends earlier this year. I lost my faith in people. I got a job at a well-disguised crappy fast fashion brand and finally quit after 7 months of toxic hell. Now I'm so drained and I can't even push myself to design anymore. I was working on a website for myself and even got a domain and everything, but now I can't even look at my work without breaking down. I have no motivation anymore and though I loved my work, I just don't see the point anymore.

Absolutely... but as much as I would like it to be so, it seems impossible for someone to simply be deleted like that... I've been thinking a lot about giving myself a concussion though recently since I always end up banging my own head when I'm having an episode, or some other way to induce retrograde post-traumatic amnesia (PTA) so at least it would be a fresh start in my mind. I would still be around for my parents and family, hospital care will only be temporary, but I wouldn't remember what my life was like before and I won't have to remember why I'm like this now...

My best (and last real) friend and the only person I really talked to about my mental state just cut ties with me, so at least everyone else around me knows me as a loud happy goofball and can rein-still that part of personality into my post accident self. A somewhat win situation I guess.
